Ok but cumbersome. Chat-GPT for free is better.. When you diagnose a problem and we apply the remedy you don ‘t check back in on how the remedy is working nor set a science based reminder window to check if it’s time to repeat it. You also don’t provide a space for us to identify which treatment method we used so you can make the appropriate retreatment window recommendation.
I don’t see a location to toggle a schedule for regular spraying of preventatives such as calcium on tomatoes or antifungals, and which plants it should be applied and then a checkmark once it’s done, resetting the time clock. 
Also, even though you have the ability to see our local weather you’re not modifying the watering schedule for plants that are outdoors, uncovered, after rain.

The free version of ChatGPT does all of this when asked. 

Please fix these or it isn’t worth the money.


*in addition, it has been raining here for 40 minutes. 40! It just sent me an alert to water my plants. And it alerted me to water all of my plants, rather indoor, under a patio or outdoor. All of the ones that are on a cycle without any smart identification. 
Yesterday I used the treatment they recommended for plants such as vinegar mix or baking soda and water… 
But when I took a photo to diagnose, it, wanted me to add it as a whole new plant rather than diagnosing a problem within that plant, and then creating a tracking system of what I used to treat it with, how well it works, how often to recheck, how often to retreat and how to proactively prevent future infection infections. 
This is a very basic, low level AI app that is good at identifying plants and problems, but useless for planning.
